posts.title: This too shan't last
posts.description: Oh no the Roncy QBC is ending! :-( Things are impermanent, and that's just part of life. Today I called with my friends, one of them has a 5 month old baby and they couldn't stop gushing about her. I started a new job. There's been a lot of ups and down at this new job. I return home each day exhausted. Continuing to deal with the cigarette smoker neighbour, it angers me each time.

posts.title: a snapshot of 2025
posts.description: It feels quite personal posting these here. The blog now has my name attached to it, which is a big step for me. Owning my work. I'm not really sure the vibe I'm going for here, but I think posting pictures can help with my writing. March I can't believe it was still so snowy.
